# /healthcheck — Performs a comprehensive health check of the repository: validates builds, runs tests, checks linting, verifies configuration files, and reports on the overall state of the codebase across all detected tech stacks.

## When to Use

Invoke this command when the user requests or implies the
`healthcheck` operation.

## Purpose

Performs a comprehensive health check of the repository: validates builds, runs tests, checks linting, verifies configuration files, and reports on the overall state of the codebase across all detected tech stacks.

## Shared State

This command participates in the shared workflow state. Read and update:

- **AGENT_BACKLOG.md** — Prioritized work items; read before starting, update when adding/completing tasks
- **.windsurf/state/orchestrator.json** — Phase, team status, metrics; read for context
- **.windsurf/state/events.log** — Append a log line when completing significant actions

## Flags

| Flag        | Description                                                       | Default |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--stack`   | Check only a specific tech stack (node, dotnet, rust, python)     | —       |
| `--project` | Scope health check to a specific project or package in a monorepo | —       |
| `--fix`     | Attempt to auto-fix discovered issues                             | false   |
| `--verbose` | Include detailed output for each check                            | false   |

## Implementation

Execute the steps defined in the corresponding command (`.windsurf/commands/healthcheck.md`). The full specification and allowed tools are in that file.
